Speed Sensor Adaptors



These cables and adaptors work with Dakota Digital's 620001 two-wire speed sensor. The 8K sensor is sold here too.

You can get a stubby GM cable, a flexible 6.25 inch GM cable and a stubby Ford cable. There's also a split nut adaptor for VW speedometer cables and a speed sensor plug for 1983-95 Ford Mustangs.

Dakota Digital doesn't include or sell the nylon driven gears.

Part # Description
 130006   Coupler nuts for GM and Chrysler transmissions 7/8" x 18 threaded cable outputs. 
 130007   6.25" Speedometer cable for GM and Chrysler transmissions 7/8" x 18 threaded cable outputs. Used to bring your 2 wire sensor away from your transmission to clear an obstruction such as shift linkage, trans. tunnel or exhaust.
 130008   Coupler nuts for Ford, Tremec and some Chrysler transmissions. Requires that you reuse your existing or aftermarket nylon driven gear.
 130010   Split coupler nut assemble for adapting your Volkswagon speedometer cable to a Dakota Digital 2 wire sensor.
540008  1983- 94 Ford Mustang Speedometer Sensor Plug used to block off stock cable drive output on OEM combination Cable/ VSS speedometer/ cruise control drive on transmission. (not Pictured)
